# Linux/WSL2 + Bash: download/review only, never execute here.
REVIEW_DIR=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/yabs-review.XXXXXX") &&
curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 --max-time 60 -fsSLo "$REVIEW_DIR/yabs.sh" https://raw.githubusercontent.com/masonr/yet-another-bench-script/master/yabs.sh &&
printf 'Mutable master snapshot; record SHA256 and inspect before any separate test.\n' &&
sha256sum "$REVIEW_DIR/yabs.sh" && less "$REVIEW_DIR/yabs.sh"
